intro.en: Automotive primary wire is selected by circuit, route, installation zone, terminal system and governing specification rather than colour or nominal gauge alone.
intro.zh: 汽车电线应依据回路、路径、安装温区、端子系统和适用规范选择，不能只看颜色或标称线径。

knowledge.en: SAE J1128, the ISO 19642 series and customer specifications define different construction and validation frameworks. The exact type and revision must be identified for each project.
knowledge.zh: SAE J1128、ISO 19642 系列与客户规范分别建立不同结构和验证框架，每个项目都应明确准确类型与版本。

notes.en: Provide current, duty, voltage, route length, temperature zones, fluids, abrasion, terminal system, colour, marking and required cable specification.
notes.zh: 请提供电流、占空比、电压、路径长度、温区、介质、磨损、端子系统、颜色印字与所需线缆规范。

delivery.en: Release records the exact cable source and designation, conductor and insulation criteria, colour and marking, cut and strip dimensions, terminal pairing and agreed harness validation.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线材来源与型号、导体和绝缘判定、颜色印字、裁线剥线尺寸、端子配对与约定线束验证。

introduction.en: The Wire Is Part of the Vehicle System
introduction.zh: 线材是车辆系统的一部分

subtitle.en: Select the electrical path by circuit, zone and terminal system
subtitle.zh: 按回路、温区与端子系统选择电气路径

lead.en: Start with current and route length, then coordinate conductor, insulation, terminal and installed environment.
lead.zh: 先确认电流与路径长度，再协同选择导体、绝缘、端子和安装环境。
